judgments.reason: Dataset is named for Forenzo & He 2023 with the same DOI, 25 subjects, 5 sessions, and MI+spatial attention paradigm; this paper reports the recording of exactly this data.
judgments.paper_title: Integrating Simultaneous Motor Imagery and Spatial Attention for EEG-BCI Control

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to curate this dataset; it does not describe the Forenzo & He motor imagery data.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/standard extension for organizing EEG data, used to format this dataset, not a paper describing the Forenzo & He motor imagery data.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
